NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Let the mid points of the sides of a triangle $ABC$ be $\left(\frac{5}{2},7\right)$, $\left(\frac{5}{2},3\right)$ and $(4,5)$. If its incentre is $(h,k)$, then $3h+k$ is equal to :
stem.hi: माना त्रिभुज $ABC$ की भुजाओं के मध्य-बिंदु $\left(\frac{5}{2},7\right)$, $\left(\frac{5}{2},3\right)$ और $(4,5)$ हैं। यदि इसका अंतःकेंद्र $(h,k)$ है, तो $3h+k$ बराबर है :

feynman.en: Each vertex equals the sum of the two midpoints next to it minus the opposite midpoint. With the vertices known, the incentre is the side-length-weighted average of the vertices.
feynman.hi: प्रत्येक शीर्ष, उसके पास के दो मध्य-बिंदुओं के योग में से सामने वाले मध्य-बिंदु को घटाने पर मिलता है। शीर्ष ज्ञात होने पर अंतःकेंद्र भुजा-लंबाइयों से भारित शीर्षों का औसत है।

steps.en: Opposite sides: $(4,1)$ faces $5$, $(4,9)$ faces $5$, $(1,5)$ faces $8$. Incentre $=\frac{5(4,1)+5(4,9)+8(1,5)}{18}=\left(\frac{8}{3},5\right)$.
